title: The Outdoor Shower – Portable Camping Shower with USB Charging
descriptionHtml:
Sweaty, salty and dusty – but the shower is miles away

You know the feeling: day three at the campsite, the salt water is sticky and your hair has given up. Everyone around you pretends it's part of the charm. It isn't.

The solution: a real shower – anywhere

Drop the pump in a bucket or the lake, press the button and enjoy an even, comfortable flow of water. The Outdoor Shower turns any water source into a warm summer shower in 10 seconds.

Features

  • Warm shower anywhere – bucket, jerry can, lake or stream
  • Several showers on one charge – charges via USB
  • 3-in-1 head – shower, hose and spray in one
  • Takes up minimal space in your pack
  • For camping, boat, festival – and washing the dog

Right to change your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
